info.name: University Management System API v1
info.description:
# UMS API

Import this collection, set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:5000`), then set email and password and log in to save tokens automatically. Use `admin@ums.edu` / `Admin@1234`, `instructor@ums.edu` / `Instructor@1234`, or `student@ums.edu` / `Student@1234` for each role. IDs are variables: obtain them from list/detail responses and set the matching collection variable.

Auth uses Bearer access tokens. The API also sets an HTTP-only refresh cookie; Postman stores cookies automatically, and refresh/logout can instead send `refreshToken` in JSON.

Role examples from `prisma/seed.ts`: `admin@ums.edu` / `Admin@1234`, `instructor@ums.edu` / `Instructor@1234`, `student@ums.edu` / `Student@1234`. Seed data has to be loaded first.

Academic routes are mounted under `/api/v1` in `src/routes/index.ts`. Google requires a real ID token and configured client ID. Payments require Stripe configuration; webhook requests need a valid Stripe signature and should be tested through Stripe CLI. IDs must be valid UUIDs. Query filter examples are disabled by default.
